L2·N8653unmasked layer
Fires on word-medial sub-word fragments that continue a rare multi-token word or proper name (e.g. Sh-avu-ot, Midd-let-own, Ch-upa, Pyrid-ox-ine, Bibli-olat-ry), i.e. it's a mid-word continuation-piece detector rather than a semantic one; the same fragments in other words (ham-let, Sh-akes, H-am-ish) drive it strongly negative.

L2·N9895unmasked layer
Fires on mid-word continuation sub-tokens that complete rare proper nouns or compound words (e.g. "-on" in "Marton", "cole" in "narcolepsy", "ir" in "Vashj'ir", "Speed" in "PageSpeed"), rather than on any coherent semantic category.
